cards.text: Zechariah, a prophet (Zechariah 1:1), has been seeing visions in the night (Zechariah 1:8). The angel who's been speaking with him comes back and wakes him, as a man is awakened from his sleep. Friend, when the angel came for me in that junk drawer, I was ALREADY wide awake, so I never even got the dramatic wake-up.

cards.question: The angel asks, “What do you see?” Zechariah describes a solid gold lampstand with a bowl at the top and ___ lamps on it, each with a spout.
Beside the gold lampstand, one on the right of the bowl and one on the left, Zechariah sees two trees. What kind are they?

cards.text: Zechariah asks the angel, “What are these, my lord?” and the angel answers with a question of his own: “Do you not know what they are?” Friend, that's not an answer, that's a BOOMERANG.

cards.question: When the angel asks if he knows what these things are, Zechariah tells him he doesn't know.

cards.text: Zechariah says no, so the angel tells him this is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah (Haggai 1:1). Friend, I once nodded along for TEN whole minutes while a baker explained a stand mixer to me, so this man's honesty is an INSPIRATION.

cards.question: The LORD's word to Zerubbabel says not by might nor by power. Then by what?

cards.text: Then the word turns to a mountain: “What are you, O great mountain?” Friend, I've had some long talks with stubborn dough, but never once with a MOUNTAIN.

cards.question: The word tells the great mountain that it will become a ___.
The capstone comes out with shouts of “Grace, grace to it!” Who does the LORD's word say will bring it forth?

cards.text: Then the word of the LORD comes to Zechariah: the hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. The book of Ezra says Zerubbabel began to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem (Ezra 5:2).

cards.question: The LORD's word says Zerubbabel's hands laid the foundation of the house, but someone else's hands will complete it.

cards.text: And the word goes on: “Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent me to you.”
Then the word asks, “For who has despised the day of small things?” Friend, my very first stamp looked like somebody SAT on the dough, and I'm STILL proud of it.

cards.question: When the seven eyes of the LORD, which scan the whole earth, see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel, they will ___.

cards.text: Zechariah's got more questions, and he asks the angel, “What are the two olive trees on the right and left of the lampstand?” Friend, he's the guy at the end of the meeting going “Just ONE more question,” and you KNOW another one's coming.

cards.question: Zechariah also asks about two olive branches beside two gold pipes. What pours from those pipes?

cards.text: The angel asks, “Do you not know what these are?” and once again Zechariah tells him no. I love it, friend, the man is CONSISTENT.

cards.question: At last the angel answers Zechariah's question about the olive trees and branches. What does he say they are?

answers.text: Two anointed ones standing beside the Lord
Two watchmen standing on the city wall
Two guards standing at the temple gate

cards.text: And that's the end of this vision. But keep that apron on, friend, because Zechariah has more to see.
